## Goal
Required checks that are fast (<8 min), deterministic, and catch the failure modes of parallel agents: ownership drift, contract edits, lockfile fights, robotic prompts, red main.

## Owns
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
- `.github/workflows/automerge.yml`
- `.github/workflows/ci-failure-router.yml`
- `.github/workflows/claude-review.yml`
- `.github/workflows/claude.yml`
- `scripts/ci/**`
- `package.json`
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`
- `pnpm-workspace.yaml`
- `tsconfig.json`
- `tsconfig.base.json`
- `vitest.config.ts`
- `Makefile`
- `.mcp.json`
- `.cursor/mcp.json`
- `engines/livekit-agent/uv.lock`
- `agents/uv.lock`

## Tests first (write them, see them fail, then implement)
- Unit tests for scripts/ci/* (ownership, contract guard, PR tag parsing).

## Steps
- Own the lockfiles: batch dependency requests from CHANGE_REQUESTS into one PR per day.
- Keep CI under 8 minutes with pnpm cache and parallel jobs.
- Tune claude-review.yml so it blocks only on checklist violations, not style nits.
- Verify ci-failure-router tags the right agent for Devin, Cursor and Claude PRs.

## Acceptance
- Median CI time < 8 min.
- A PR touching a file outside its issue fails "ownership".
- A PR editing contracts/ without the contract-change label fails.

## Run
`pnpm vitest run orchestration scripts/ci` and `make test` before opening the PR.
